weigh_in_status: All bouts remain on. Ismael Bonfim weighed 163.5 for lightweight, Ketlen Souza 117 for strawweight, and Brendson Ribeiro 208.5 for light heavyweight. Those three bouts proceed at catchweight with purse forfeitures. Allen and Duncan made middleweight for the five-round main event.
identity_audit: Completed before the official lock. Allen Frye Jr., Felipe Franco and Leon Shahbazyan missing/stale static profile measurements were repaired from current UFC profile data. Kai Kamaka III's older UFCStats history under the display name Kai Kamaka was merged into the current identity before feature construction. The unaudited preliminary run is not official.
tape_policy: Direct continuous video playback is unavailable in this environment. Official UFC replay/full-fight/profile history links were located where available, and regional/current metadata was used for sparse fighters. No claim is made that visual tape was watched. Every matchup remains explicitly classified below.
